subject.title: [Bug]: Scheduled isolated agentTurn outer run records error although session ended success

question: Should successful isolated cron execution with a post-run delivery-send failure persist as `status=ok` plus delivery-specific fields, or should this wait for a broader warning-status contract?
rationale: Both shapes are technically plausible and affect operator alerts, backoff, and status-only consumers, so code inspection cannot safely choose the public cron status semantics without maintainer intent.

options.title: Accept narrow status split
options.body: Land the narrow fix so successful isolated execution remains `ok` and delivery failure is reported through `deliveryStatus`, `deliveryError`, and diagnostics.

options.title: Defer to warning status
options.body: Keep this issue open behind the broader warning-status work if maintainers want a new public partial-success run state instead of reusing `ok`.

options.title: Keep current error semantics
options.body: Treat delivery failure as primary cron failure and document that status-only consumers should expect `error` for undelivered scheduled output.

recommendation.title: Accept narrow status split
recommendation.body: Land the narrow fix so successful isolated execution remains `ok` and delivery failure is reported through `deliveryStatus`, `deliveryError`, and diagnostics.

likelyOwner.reason: Peter has the strongest current blame/history signal across the finalizer and scheduler status paths and is the best available owner for the semantics decision.
